text:
micah: Quick async check — I'm about to widen the int8 rollout but want an audit on fallback/guardrails first. Two asks: confirm fallback criteria are correct, and confirm monitoring + auto-rollback hooks are wired. TL;DR below with config and links.

tara: Thanks — can you paste the exact flag names and canary sizes? trying to update the dashboard filters.

micah: sure — current patch is in PR #4123. config excerpt:```
feature_flag: quant_precision_toggle_v3
canary_policy:
  canary_pct: 1.0   # percent of production traffic
  step_up: [1.0, 5.0, 20.0]
  fallback_threshold: -0.02   # allowed quality delta (relative)
  safety_triggers:
    latency_p95_ms: 200
    error_rate_delta: 0.01
    perplexity_delta: 0.03
auto_actions:
  on_trigger: rollback_to_variant: fp16_v2026_04_01
  notify: #infra #sre #ml
```

micah: dashboard + playbook here: https://dashboard.redwood.internal/d/rl/quant-rollouts?org=eng-ml and playbook: https://wiki.redwood/internal/quant-rollout-playbook (check section "fallback thresholds").

samir: quick q — what's the metric we use for quality? perplexity or eval set pass rate? last run used both but we alert on pass rate drop > 2%.

micah: we monitor both. primary alarm is "eval_pass_rate" (window=30m, delta <= -0.02), secondary is perplexity. If either trips plus latency spike, trigger automatic rollback.

nina: pinging on model-variant fallback: can we add a soft fallback strategy instead of immediate rollback? e.g., start routing 10% to fp16 and observe for 10m before full rollback. reduces shock to customers.

micah: good call. I can update auto_actions to: on_trigger -> start_gradual_fallback(10% for 10m) then full rollback if metrics still bad. I'll update the PR.

jordan: I left a code-review note on #4123 about missing unit tests around the policy parser. can we add a simple table-driven test for `step_up` parsing? small ask.

samir: volunteering to run the smoke harness against the canary audience. Will run the `smoke_int8_harness.sh` with sample size 1k and post quick metrics. ETA 30m.

tara: also: canary audience should exclude high-value customers — ensure `audience_tag != prod_enterprise` in the routing rule. we almost hit that last time.

micah: noted, will add `exclude_tags: [prod_enterprise, pci]` to policy.

nina: also confirm logging of model variant in request traces so SRE can easily diff traces when troubleshooting.

micah: yes traces include `model_variant` and `precision_profile` fields now.

jordan: :thumbsup: on gradual fallback plan. once tests pass and samir posts harness results, I'm fine with canary step up to 5%.

samir: quick smoke results (1k requests):
- eval_pass_rate delta: -0.005 (within threshold)
- latency p95 delta: +8% (baseline 180ms -> 194ms)
- error_rate delta: +0.002
no alerts triggered. posting raw logs to the run: https://logs.redwood.internal/runs/7965

micah: great. I'll update the PR to add gradual fallback, exclude_tags, and a unit test. tagging @deploy-bot to schedule a canary window.

deploy-bot: Canary window scheduled for 2026-04-12T16:40:00Z -> 2026-04-12T18:40:00Z on quant_precision_toggle_v3, initial canary 1%. Monitoring hooks: eval_pass_rate, perplexity, latency_p95, error_rate.

tara: I'll update the dashboard filters and add the `prod_enterprise` exclusion to the realtime panel.

micah: thanks all. please react with :thumbsup: if you approve merging the PR once I push the change. will wait 20m for any objections.

tara: :thumbsup:
jordan: :thumbsup:
nina: :thumbsup:
samir: :thumbsup:
micah: merging in 10m unless anything else.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 1965432280 (canary id c-8972)."
